acceptanceCriteria.text: Functional CLI smoke resolves and executes `mottainai` from the exact active managed generation/store path.
MCP protocol smoke resolves and executes `mottainai-mcp` from the same exact active managed generation/store path.
The smoke path is derived from canonical managed-generation state/metadata rather than ambient `PATH`.
A deliberately conflicting ambient `mottainai`/`mottainai-mcp` cannot satisfy the smoke.
Missing or non-executable binaries in the active generation fail closed and prevent `managedRuntimeReady` certification.
Evidence records the active generation identity and executable paths used for the CLI/MCP smoke.
Regression coverage proves direct Route 3 -> 2 -> 1 and Lima/provider smoke use the same semantic executable authority.
Existing bounded MCP protocol timeout/diagnostics remain intact.

issue.title: fix(runtime): bind CLI and MCP functional smoke to the active managed generation
